releaseNotes:
- NEW: SOS now rings, vibrates and alerts YOU while it's active - no more wondering if it went through
- NEW: Snooze your SOS alerts (5/15/30 min) with a live countdown and Resume button
- You'll get a vibrate + sound when a volunteer accepts, and again if your SOS escalates to a wider area
- Update prompt now appears reliably on every launch and resume
- SOS sends instantly using your last known location
- Home screen loads faster and keeps your data visible while refreshing
- Language switcher fixed (no more overlap)
- Settings > Data and permissions rewritten in plain language
- Friendlier error messages in English & Urdu
